propositions: A structurally divergent verifier response can normalize to an empty result and be treated as a valid review outcome.
A semantically empty verification (raw-empty or malformed-to-empty) must never yield a valid pass and instead becomes indeterminate or contract-failure.
pass3_decide already routes any finding lacking a verification entry to indeterminate, covering both empty paths.
Telemetry must separately count clean, recovered, empty-outcome, and unrecoverable responses via outcome_counts.
Flexible parsing, bounded retries, and provider-independent self-healing must be preserved without schema rigidity.
Pipeline-level wiring of verify_findings telemetry into plan_review_decide and code_review_decide is missing and deferred to a follow-up ticket.
